objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object in the paperless system that can be created, edited, released, and distributed. Documents are organized by type and level (Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction) and go through versioning and approval workflows.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document identifier composed of abbreviation, consecutive number, and title

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle such as Draft, Released, Out of Force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when the document validity expires

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Duration period for which document remains valid before review is required

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The actual text and information contained in the document

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Pre-defined structure or format that can be applied when creating a new document

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data relevant to this document

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Information systems or applications referenced by the document

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Organizations or corporate entities to which the document applies

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Geographic, organizational, or functional areas where the document is valid

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Primary person responsible for creating and initially signing the document

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional person with change rights on the document

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person responsible for checking document content for technical and formal aspects

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person authorized to approve and release the document for distribution

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person authorized to translate the document into other languages

attributes.name: reader_group
attributes.description: User group assigned permission to view the document

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the document object was created in the system

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language in which the document is written

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period of time the document is retained after being declared out of force

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document supplement that is automatically released with the main document, has its own versioning, and triggers a new version of the main document when modified or archived.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document, does not require dual control approval, and can be deleted without affecting the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request for modifying an existing document that does not affect the content or version history until it is scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated workflow request to review and potentially extend the validity of a document nearing expiration.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A workflow request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has valid content or has expired.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A workflow request to re-validate and restore a previously archived or invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with the system in one or more defined roles and permissions.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned together for permission and distribution management purposes.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A special user group that retains read access to archived documents after all other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: A user group with permission to create reactivation requests for archived documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of users and user groups assigned to receive document notifications and acknowledgement requests.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to document the approval process and maintain audit trail.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: An assigned activity in the approval or acknowledgement process that must be completed by a designated participant.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: System-maintained record of all changes, signatures, and actions performed on a document.
